messages:
Kevin: Heads up — Orion Health CISO just paused the POC until we answer a security questionnaire and confirm Dedicated pricing. They want answers by EOD Friday or they'll ask execs for a vendor freeze. Tagging @Maria @Sam @Priya to triage.
Maria: Got it. do we have the questionnaire? deadline confirmed = EOD Fri?
Sam: They uploaded a 40-question PDF to the portal a few minutes ago: https://files.redwood.internal/orion/sec-q-2026.pdf. I'll start a pass but will need infra details for KMS/VPC/network controls.
Priya: Send the PDF to me as well. If they're asking for FedRAMP specifically that's a big ask; we can offer Private (on-prem/VPC) + KMS but not FedRAMP attestation. I'll draft legal responses for DPA/SCCs and pen-test summaries.
Jun: For Dedicated we support customer-managed TLS termination + VPC peering and can integrate with AWS KMS for key wrapping. If they want HSM-backed keys we can do it in Private only. I can produce a short spec. ETA 48 hours for the writeup.
Kevin: Sales question — they're asking for committed throughput pricing for Dedicated (3 GPU pool equivalent) and a POC discount. Maria, can you propose numbers? If it's >40% discount I'll need exec signoff.
Maria: Drafting proposal: 3-month POC, 50% off list, then month-to-month at committed capacity with a 12-month upgrade credit. If that's too deep, suggest 30% and include migration credit.
Lisa: I can attach our SOC2 Type II report and the latest penetration test executive summary. We don't have FedRAMP. Also note: our runtime supports prefix caching and token limits that should be highlighted to reduce their SLO concerns.
Priya: I'll prepare the legal/controls answer doc by tomorrow EOD. If they request contract redlines for data residency or audit rights we should escalate to Legal Ops immediately.
Sam: Scheduling — I'll set a call with their security engineer for tomorrow 11am PT. Jun, can you join? Kevin, would be good if you or Maria can join for pricing nuance.
Jun: I can join 11am PT. Also need to know whether the POC will run in their AWS account (VPC) or in our Dedicated pool — that'll change the answers in the network section.
Maria: Sales recon — customer prefers Dedicated inside our cloud region but wants the option to move to Private later for compliance. I'll confirm during the call.
Kevin: For exec briefing: I'll prepare a one-page escalation note summarizing ask, risks, and the recommended POC deal (including discount cap). If we need an exception to >40% discount, I'll escalate to Ops Execs.
ops-bot: :information_source: Document uploaded to sales drive: /sales/deals/orion/esc/2026-03-security-answers-draft.md
Priya: Action items I have: legal responses + DPA checklist by tomorrow EOD.
Jun: Action: network/KMS spec + clear matrix for Dedicated vs Private by 48h.
Sam: Action: confirm call + walk through questionnaire, prepare demo checklist focusing on KV cache and latency SLOs.
Maria: Action: pricing draft and POC commercial terms by EOD today.
Kevin: I'll collect these and aim to send the exec briefing to the CTO and Head of Sales by Friday morning. Keep updates here — if anything blocks your timeline ping me directly. :thumbsup:
Maria: Will update after the call.
Sam: Logged — will upload my notes to the thread after the 11am call.
Priya: FYI I already flagged one risky clause about customer audit windows; might propose standardizing a 48h notice window instead of their 24h.
Kevin: Noted. Thanks team — this is high priority for Q2 ACV.
Maria: :rocket:
